notes: Template: TBox expansion, fictional subject: a made-up class of whole numbers (the quenzils) given the revision's relation (has_parity) and new object (odd). Paired with mathematics-replace-0020. The earlier version said the sum of two even quenzils is odd, which overrode the rule for whole numbers (the sum of two evens is even). The class now sits under whole numbers, whose parity is left open for a subclass (some are odd), so nothing real is overwritten; the sum rule itself cannot be kept for any class of whole numbers, so this is the closest non-conflicting expansion that keeps the pair's relation and new value. Members are named in the prompts (Q, h, a bag's marble count), so only the propositional side facts need checks. Derived (inheritance, 2 hops): parity of a large unnamed member, the remainder on division by 2, and a sharing story. The near query (two odds add to an even) stays about the neighbouring rule and is not changed by the edit (Rule 7). Insert: no original answers, no derivability, determinate only.
